links.outcome: Proportion of AI echo measurements differing clinically significantly from CMR
links.effect: Clinically significant differences between AI and CMR in 36.7% of LVOT, 20% of STJ, and 11.8% of SoV measurements; the authors conclude physician oversight remains necessary.
links.quote: Clinically significant differences (≥2 mm for LVOT and ≥4 mm for STJ and SoV) between AI and CMR measurements were observed in 36.7% of LVOT, 20% of STJ, and 11.8% of SoV measurements.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial AI software (US2.ai) for echocardiographic measurement accuracy against expert human readers and CMR, concluding that physician oversight remains necessary due to significant measurement discrepancies.
